story.text: 전주 한옥마을의 아침은 안개로 자욱했다. 기와지붕 위로 옅은 햇살이 번지기 시작했다.
story.reading: jeon-ju han-ok-ma-eul-ui a-chim-eun an-gae-ro ja-uk-haet-da. gi-wa-ji-bung wi-ro yeot-eun haet-sal-i beon-ji-gi si-jak-haet-da.
story.en: The morning in Jeonju Hanok Village was thick with fog. A pale sunlight was beginning to spread over the tiled roofs.

story.text: 나는 늦잠을 자려다가, 알람 소리에 억지로 눈을 떴다. 오늘도 하늘과 아침 산책을 하기로 한 날이었다.
story.reading: na-neun neut-jam-eul ja-ryeo-da-ga, al-lam so-ri-e eok-ji-ro nun-eul tteot-da. o-neul-do ha-neul-gwa a-chim san-chaek-eul ha-gi-ro han nal-i-eot-da.
story.en: I'd been tempted to sleep in, but the alarm forced my eyes open. Today was another day I'd promised to take a morning walk with Haneul.

story.text: 골목을 나서자 그가 벌써 담벼락에 기대어 서 있었다. 비번인데도 옷차림은 흐트러짐 하나 없었다.
story.reading: gol-mok-eul na-seo-ja geu-ga beol-sseo dam-byeo-rag-e gi-dae-eo seo iss-eot-da. bi-beon-in-de-do ot-cha-rim-eun heu-teu-reo-jim ha-na eop-seot-da.
story.en: The moment I stepped into the alley, he was already there, leaning against the wall. Even off duty, not a single thread of his outfit was out of place.

story.text: '잘 잤어?' 그가 툭 던지듯 물었다. 다정한 말투는 아니었지만, 눈은 내 얼굴을 살피고 있었다.
story.reading: 'jal jja-sseo?' geu-ga tuk deon-ji-deut mul-eot-da. da-jeong-han mal-tu-neun a-ni-eot-ji-man, nun-eun nae eol-gul-eul sal-pi-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: "Sleep okay?" he tossed out the question bluntly. His tone wasn't warm, but his eyes were quietly checking my face.

story.text: '그럭저럭요.' 하품을 참으며 대답하자, 그는 말없이 따뜻한 캔 음료 하나를 내밀었다. 아침부터 준비해 온 모양이었다.
story.reading: 'geu-reok-jeo-reok-yo.' ha-pum-eul cham-eu-myeo dae-dab-ha-ja, geu-neun mal-eop-si tta-tteut-han kaen eum-nyo ha-na-reul nae-mil-eot-da. a-chim-bu-teo jun-bi-hae on mo-yang-i-eot-da.
story.en: "So-so," I answered, swallowing a yawn. Without a word, he held out a warm canned drink. He must have prepared it that very morning.

story.text: '아침엔 뭐라도 마셔.' 짧은 한마디였지만, 그 안에 걱정이 얼마나 눌러 담겨 있는지 나는 알고 있었다.
story.reading: 'a-chim-en mwo-ra-do ma-syeo.' jjalb-eun han-ma-di-eot-ji-man, geu an-e geok-jeong-i eol-ma-na nul-leo dam-gyeo iss-neun-ji na-neun al-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: "Drink something, at least, in the morning." It was just a short line, but I knew exactly how much worry was pressed into it.

story.text: 우리는 나란히 골목을 걸었다. 안개가 걷히며 새로운 하루가 열리고 있었다.
story.reading: u-ri-neun na-ran-hi gol-mok-eul geol-eot-da. an-gae-ga geot-hi-myeo sae-ro-un ha-ru-ga yeol-li-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: We walked side by side down the alley. As the fog lifted, a new day was opening up.

story.text: '오늘 하루도 잘 시작해보자.' 그가 무심한 척 중얼거렸다. 나는 웃음이 났다. 그와 함께라면 오늘도 나쁘지 않을 것 같았다.
story.reading: 'o-neul ha-ru-do jal si-jak-hae-bo-ja.' geu-ga mu-sim-han cheok jung-eol-geo-ryeot-da. na-neun us-eum-i nat-da. geu-wa ham-kke-ra-myeon o-neul-do na-ppeu-ji anh-eul geot gat-at-da.
story.en: "Let's start today off right." He muttered it like it was nothing. I couldn't help but smile. With him around, today didn't seem so bad either.

words.example_en: In the morning, one cup of coffee is enough for me.

words.meaning: to wake up, to get up
words.example_en: I get up at seven o'clock every day.
Did you sleep well last night?

sentences.en: Have a great day today too.
Shall we start the day now?
I get up at seven o'clock.
